style="font-size:1px;width:100%"><tbody><tr><td style="BORDER-BOTTOM: 2px solid;"/></tr><tr><td style="BORDER-BOTTOM: 5px solid;"/></tr></tbody></table><table style="border-spacing:0;font:10pt times style="page-break-after: always"></p></td></tr><tr style="height:15px"><td>&#160;</td></tr></tbody></table><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;"><strong>Item 8.01. Other Events.</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;"><strong>October 2026 Launch of Almighty Cleaners</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">Barrel Energy, Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) reports that its Happy Traps business plans to begin bringing to market a line of cleaners and degreasers under the name &#8220;Almighty Cleaners&#8221; in October 2026.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">Happy Traps collects used cooking oil and grease-trap waste. By-products recovered from these collected materials are being converted into cleaners and degreasers for the Almighty Cleaners product line. The products are intended to be marketed as eco-friendly cleaners and degreasers.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">The initiative expands Happy Traps&#8217; activities from waste collection into the commercialization of products made using recovered materials. The Company has not provided revenue projections for the product line in this report.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;"><strong>Forward-Looking Statements</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">This report contains forward-looking statements concerning the planned October 2026 market introduction of Almighty Cleaners and the commercialization of cleaners and degreasers using recovered by-products. These statements reflect current expectations and are subject to risks and uncertainties, including production capacity, the availability and suitability of recovered materials, product performance, compliance with applicable requirements, distribution arrangements and customer acceptance. Actual timing and results may differ materially. The Company undertakes no obligation to update these statements except as required by law.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;"><strong>Item 9.01. Financial Statements and Exhibits.</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">(d) Exhibits.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><table style="border-spacing:0;text-align:left;font:10pt times new roman;width:100%" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr style="height:15px;background-color:#cceeff"><td style="width:4%;"><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">104</p></td><td style="vertical-align:top;">Cover Page Interactive Data File (to be embedded within the Inline XBRL filing).</td></tr></tbody></table><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&#160;
